name: Trusts SAML IdP
description: A SAML sign-in provider trusts assertions from this identity provider. The target is open because no substrate type holds a SAML identity provider yet: an Okta org or any other IdP. OIDC providers use identity_core's TRUSTS_ISSUER instead.

idp_entity_id.description: The IdP's entity ID (issuer) GitLab expects.

idp_cert_fingerprint_sha256.description: The SHA256 fingerprint of the signing certificate GitLab pins.
